nodes.title: MS_WORKFLOW_NOTE
widgets_values:
# Music Suite Official Workflow

ID: minimax-h3.t2v.v3-graded
Purpose: pure text-to-video with joint audio.
Derived from the flf2v graded graph: the only functional change is that
MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo.first_frame / .last_frame are left unconnected,
which is exactly how comfy-core switches that node from fl2va to t2va.

Created using Anthropic Claude - keep this line on internal
versions until a human has reviewed and verified the graph.

## Contract (titled, patchable nodes)
- MS_INPUT_TRANSFORMER_GGUF / _INT8 / _NVFP4 - the three loaders.
  MS_MODEL_SELECT picks the first one that is NOT bypassed
  (rgthree Any Switch). Same rule for MS_CLIP_SELECT.
  NOTE: there is no single MS_INPUT_TRANSFORMER node any more.
  If the Music Suite patcher resolves that exact title, point it
  at the three suffixed titles instead.
- MS_INPUT_PROMPT   - prompt text
- MS_INPUT_FIRST_FRAME / MS_INPUT_LAST_FRAME - keyframes. Each one
  passes through a Fit-To-Canvas resize driven by the SAME width /
  height as the model: an FL2VA keyframe occupies a real frame
  position and must match the target canvas.
  For first+last, un-bypass MS_INPUT_LAST_FRAME *and* its resize.
- MS_INPUT_RESOLUTION - aspect + megapixels. 0.98 MP 16:9 = 1344x768,
  which is H3's native 768 short edge. Drop to 0.4 MP for tests.
- MS_INPUT_DURATION   - seconds. MS_FRAME_COUNT snaps to 17n+5 using
  MS_INPUT_BASE_FPS (24). Do NOT feed the interpolated fps in here.
- MS_INPUT_BASE_FPS   - 24. Feeds the frame math and the muxer.
- MS_INPUT_INTERP_FPS - 60, only live when RIFE is enabled.
  MS_FPS_SELECT then hands the muxer 60 instead of 24.
- MS_INPUT_STEPS      - scheduler steps (20, simple)
- MS_INPUT_SEED       - noise seed
- MS_CACHE_1_SPECTRUM / _2_EASYCACHE / _3_H3 - chained in series.
  Bypassed nodes pass MODEL straight through, so leave exactly ONE
  un-bypassed. They sit AFTER MiniMaxH3SigmaShift.
- MS_OUTPUT_VIDEO     - h264 review copy. Master Export is the
  bypassed h265 sibling next to it.

## Model chain order
MS_MODEL_SELECT -> LoRA -> attention patch -> MiniMaxH3SigmaShift
-> cache chain -> guider / scheduler

## Required assets (ComfyUI/models/)
- diffusion_models/  MiniMax-H3-FL2VA-Q4_K_M.gguf            (active)
                     minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
                     minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_nvfp4_convrot_int8.safetensors
- text_encoders/     qwen3vl-32B-MiniMax-H3-Q4_K_M.gguf       (active)
- vae/               minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
                     minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors

GGUF is a community path, not the documented one. The int8_convrot
loaders are wired and ready for a same-seed A/B.

## Manual validation
1. Load in ComfyUI 0.30.0+ (native MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo required).
2. Confirm model filenames match your install.
3. Smoke test at 0.4 MP before raising resolution.
4. Queue; confirm one MP4 with video AND stereo audio under
   output/music-suite/minimax-h3/.
5. Re-export the API JSON before changing Music Suite.

nodes.title: READ ME - Attention & Cache
widgets_values:
ATTENTION - ONE MECHANISM ONLY

Currently: GGUFLoaderKJ attention = 'none',
Patch Sage Attention KJ = ON, Sol-Attn = ON.

Sage and Sol-Attn both patch attention. Pick one:
 - RTX 50-series / SM120  -> Sol-Attn, bypass the Sage patch
 - anything older         -> Sage patch, bypass Sol-Attn
   (Sol-Attn routes through flex_attention + torch.compile
    and is built for SM120)

Sol-Attn: keep exact_kv_and_rows ON. It keeps the
[text | cond | audio] prefix rows exact, and the generated
audio stream lives at the end of that prefix. Consider
dense_steps = 1 so the final denoising step runs dense -
that is where sparse approximation shows most.

CACHE CHAIN (Spectrum -> EasyCache -> H3 Cache)
Serial with bypass, so exactly ONE stays un-bypassed.
Reported on 124 frames: EasyCache ~25%, Spectrum ~15%,
and Spectrum can alter motion. Order matters - the caches
must sit AFTER MiniMaxH3SigmaShift.

[0s-1.5s] Low tracking shot races forward with the courier as he accelerates hard on the magnetic skateboard, cyan board thrusters flare brighter, rain streaks turn into diagonal streaks across the lens, neon signs smear into long light trails while the alley walls rush past on both sides.
[1.5s-3.5s] He snaps into a sharp left bank at full speed, the board sprays a sheet of water and sparks off the wet pavement, a swarm of holographic ads and floating drones whip past his head, camera whip-pans to keep him centered as background traffic blurs into pure light streaks.
[3.5s-5s] The courier launches off a sudden ramp of debris, body and board launching airborne in a tight arc through heavy rain and neon haze, camera follows the upward trajectory then drops with him as he lands hard, water exploding outward in all directions while the alley continues to rush past at extreme speed.

nodes.title: READ ME - Post Grade
widgets_values:
POST GRADE + PIPELINE FIXES (v3)
Created using Anthropic Claude - keep this note on internal versions
until the settings have been reviewed/verified.

PATH:
  VAEDecode -> RIFE -> FILM Net -> HDR -> LUT -> Trim -> Bloom
    -> Upscaler -> Sharpen -> VideoCombine

EVERYTHING IS GROUP-TOGGLEABLE. Bypass = passthrough, so any stage
you switch off in Feature Group Toggles simply hands its input on.
That is why the Any Switch was removed: a BYPASSED node still emits
an image, so 'Any Switch' always picked branch 1 and the FILM Net
result was computed and thrown away. Chaining in series is the
pattern that actually matches how the group bypasser works.
  - Do NOT enable RIFE and FILM Net at the same time. They stack
    (24 -> 60 -> 120) and the fps below will not match.

ATTENTION - both can and should be on, in this order:
  LoRA -> Sage-Attn -> Sol-Attn -> SigmaShift
Sol-Attn reads any existing optimized_attention_override and chains
onto it: it takes eligible sparse self-attention and delegates the
rest (cross-attn, short seqs, steps outside its sigma window) to
Sage. The old order had Sage last, which overwrote Sol-Attn
entirely. Verify in the console - you should now see:
  [sol_attn] chaining onto an existing attention override
If that line is missing, the order is wrong again.

FPS (MS_FPS_SELECT priority: first non-null wins):
  any_01 RIFE      60   (lives in the RIFE group)
  any_02 FILM Net  48   (lives in the FILM group, = 24 x2)
  any_03 base      24
Disabled groups emit null, so the right fps follows the toggle.
If you change FILM's multiplier, change 48 to match.

ADDING NEW TOGGLEABLE GROUPS:
The 'Feature Group Toggles' node has matchColors = brown. rgthree
resolves that to #b06634 and SKIPS every group with any other
colour. A new group must be brown or it will not appear in the
toggler (this is also why 'Video Options', which is green, has
never shown up there).

GRADE TUNING (change one at a time):
 1 Pseudo-HDR  hdr_intensity 0.45. Above ~0.8 goes haloed.
 2 LUT         strength 0.7. 0.4-0.5 if skin goes too gold.
 3 Trim        saturation/contrast +10-15 finishing pass.
 4 Bloom       bypassed; most memory-hungry node here.
 5 Sharpen     alpha 0.35 subtle, 0.6+ crunchy. Stays after the
               upscaler so it works at final resolution.

The grade runs BEFORE the upscaler: same look, ~1/4 the CPU cost
(~2.0 s/frame -> ~0.5 s/frame at 124 frames).

Requires Worlds_AMV_Style.cube in ComfyUI/models/luts/ and
colour-science in python_embeded. The LUT is an algorithmic
approximation of the Riot Worlds look, not an official Riot asset.
